Here are some practical tips to improve your phone's battery life:

**Immediate actions:**
- Lower screen brightness or enable auto-brightness
- Turn off location services when not needed
- Disable background app refresh for apps that don't need it
- Switch to Wi-Fi instead of cellular data when available
- Enable battery saver or low power mode

**Settings to check:**
- Close apps running in the background that you're not using
- Turn off push notifications for non-essential apps
- Reduce screen timeout duration
- Disable vibration for notifications (uses more power than sound)
- Turn off "Hey Siri" or "OK Google" always-listening features

**Longer-term habits:**
- Avoid letting battery drain to 0% regularly
- Don't leave phone charging overnight constantly (modern phones handle this better, but it can still affect long-term battery health)
- Keep your phone out of extreme temperatures
- Update to the latest OS version (often includes battery optimizations)

**Check for issues:**
- Look at battery usage in settings to identify apps draining power
- Consider whether your battery might be degraded (most phones show battery health in settings)

If you've tried these and still have issues, your battery might be physically degraded and need replacement, especially if your phone is 2+ years old.
